Name: SCIE-Port 移植集合 (Audit Build)
Description: Authorized SCIE port for SCNET x25.01.17. v0.28.0 rebuilds the separate Skywrath awakened Stormhammer as V3.2: two Android HUD skills (Thunderous Judgment and Myriad Tribulation), authoritative split melee damage, controlled five-point lightning retaliation, target-locked ultimate sequencing, cast/time synchronized package 242 events, layered avatar/weapon glow and high/medium/low VFX budgets. The original Stormhammer and all v0.27.0 vehicle features remain unchanged. Android rendering, touch layout, combat values and real multiplayer synchronization remain pending device verification.
